verses.1: And the LORD said to Aaron, “You and your sons, along with the house of your father, you shall carry the burdens of the Holy Place. You and your sons, you shall bear the burdens that belong to your family.”
verses.2: And also, your brothers will be brought before you as vessels used by your father. They will accompany you, and they will help you. You and your children will stand before the tabernacle of God.
verses.3: And they shall keep the laws regarding your possession and the possession of all the tabernacles. But they shall not approach anything that is holy or used for worshiping God. They shall not even touch those things either.
verses.4: And they will accompany you, and they will keep the sanctity of the Tabernacle for all the work related to it. No stranger shall be allowed to approach you.
verses.5: And you shall keep the sacred things and the utensils of the altar. There shall no longer be any punishment for the children of Israel.
verses.6: And now, I have taken your brothers from among the children of Israel. These are offerings to Jehovah, for they will serve in the Temple of God.
verses.7: And you and your children shall keep your priesthood for all things related to the worship and the Temple. You shall serve in a proper manner. I will give you your priesthood, and the stranger who approaches will die.
verses.8: And the LORD spoke to Aaron, and I have given you in charge the custody of My offerings for all the sacrifices of Israel. These offerings are given to you for burning as sacrifices, and also for your children, as a permanent ordinance.
verses.9: It shall be a holiness to you from the fire, just as all their sacrifices, all their offerings, and all their sins become holy for you. It shall be a holiness for you and for your children.
verses.10: In the holiness of the Holy One, we will eat him. Every living being will eat him. He will become holy for us.
verses.11: And this is what you shall do: You shall take a portion from each of the children of Israel, and give it to yourself, to your children, and to their children. In this way, all that is clean in your house will be able to eat it.
verses.12: All milk that is from animals that are not yet mature, and all milk that comes from animals that have not yet been bred, these are all given to you by Jehovah.
verses.13: In the courts of all those who are in their lands, those who bring them to Jehovah, every clean animal will be kept in your house and eaten by you.
verses.14: All the punishments in Israel will be yours.
verses.15: Every sacrifice that is offered to Jehovah by man or animal shall be accepted. But the death of the man who offers the sacrifice, and the death of the animal that is used as an offering, shall be punished.
verses.16: And from the beginning of the new month, you shall value it according to its true worth. It shall be valued at fifty shekels, which is the equivalent of forty gerahs.
verses.17: But in the altar of ashes, or in the altar where ashes are burned, they will not be sanctified. Their blood will be poured onto the altar, and their milk will be used to create smoke for the aroma of holiness before Jehovah.
verses.18: And by their words, you will be guided like a compass. And when your right hand moves, it will also guide you.
verses.19: All the sacred offerings that the Israelites brought to God, I have given them to you and to your descendants. This is a covenant of peace forever before God. It is a covenant for you and your descendants.
verses.20: And the LORD said to Aaron, “In their land you shall not be king over them. You will not have any share in their inheritance. I will give you a portion from among the descendants of Israel.”
verses.21: And to the descendants of Levi, I have given all that belongs to Israel as a share in their labor, for they are those who serve the Lord’s temple.
verses.22: And the children of Israel shall not again approach the altar where sin is brought to death.
verses.23: And the Levite shall perform the rituals related to the Temple of the Lord. They shall carry out these rituals forever, for your generations. And among the children of Israel, they shall not be given any inheritance.
verses.24: For all the offerings that the Israelites offered to God, I gave them to the Levites as a portion for them. Therefore, I said to them among the Israelites: “They shall not receive any portion.”
verses.25: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.26: And to the Levites, I will speak and say to them: “Take from among the children of Israel those items that I have given you as part of your inheritance. But let them not sell them at a higher price than what Jehovah has commanded. They must not sell any of these items at a higher price.”
verses.27: And it will be considered by you as a gift from heaven, a treasure from the heavens.
verses.28: Also, you shall bring back the offering of Yahweh from all the things you take from the children of Israel. You shall give back to Yahweh the offering that you have taken from them, as an offering for Aaron, the priest.
verses.29: From all your offerings, you must bring forth all the offerings of Jehovah from all his sacrifices. From us, from us alone.
verses.30: And you said to them, “In your anger, pour out your milk from us. Then we will be considered as lambs, just like a flock of sheep.”
verses.31: And you shall eat it everywhere you go, in your homes. It is like wages that you receive for your labor in the tabernacle of God.
verses.32: And do not bring sin upon him during your offerings. Do not defile his milk, nor the sacred objects of the Israelites. Do not contaminate them or destroy them.
